_comment: skfem helmholtz#8: MeshQuad.init_tensor attaches no named boundaries. Verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 -- m.boundaries is None, ib.get_dofs('left') raises ValueError("Boundary 'left' not found.") and the legacy ib.get_dofs()['left'] raises TypeError: 'DofsView' object is not subscriptable; .with_boundaries({...}) + get_dofs('left').flatten() returns the 9 left-edge nodes of a 9x9 grid. NOTE the claim's to_meshtri() sentence is FALSE on 12.0.1: .to_meshtri() PRESERVES the four tags (no reattachment needed), and this fixture pins that so a future regression in either direction is caught.
